description: Header file defining the SmsService class for handling SMS-related operations in a modem simulator, including message handling, configuration, and interaction with other services.

classes.name: SmsService
classes.description: A class that manages SMS operations within a modem simulation environment, including message handling, configuration, and interaction with other services.

methods.name: SmsService
methods.description: Constructor initializing the SMS service with service ID, channel monitor, and thread looper.

methods.name: ~SmsService
methods.description: Default destructor for SmsService.

methods.name: SetupDependency
methods.description: Sets up dependencies with the associated SimService.

methods.description: Handles the process of sending an SMS.

methods.name: HandleSMSAcknowledge
methods.description: Handles acknowledgment of received SMS.

methods.description: Checks if the service is waiting to write SMS to SIM.

methods.name: InitializeServiceState
methods.description: Initializes the internal state of the SMS service.
